    field :lat, :float, allow_nil?: true

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check: an authorized read (or aggregate) of the primary `:read`
  must select records by primary key (`Ash.get`) or load them through a
  relationship; direct view in Bubble reaches a record through a
  reference, never by listing. Otherwise it is forbidden. Enumerate
  and count with `:search`.
  Generated by bubble_ex (WTF-356); NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE.
  """
  use Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck

  alias Ash.Query.{BooleanExpression, Ref}
  alias Ash.Query.Operator.{Eq, In}

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts), do: "the read selects records by primary key"

  # A policy check, not a preparation: it also sees aggregate queries
  # (count, exists, max, ...), which run no read hooks. A
  # relationship load (`accessing_from`) is keyed by the source
  # records' IDs, possibly as `id == parent(...)`.
  @impl true
  def match?(_actor, %{query: %Ash.Query{} = query}, _opts) do
    query.context[:accessing_from] != nil or
      keyed?(query.filter && query.filter.expression, query.resource)
  end

  def match?(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp keyed?(%BooleanExpression{op: :and, left: left, right: right}, resource),
    do: keyed?(left, resource) or keyed?(right, resource)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: v, right: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%In{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(_expression, _resource), do: false

  defp key?(attribute, resource),
    do: [name(attribute)] == Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(resource)

  defp name(%{name: name}), do: name
  defp name(name), do: name
end

defmodule MyApp.Workspace do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "workspace"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :creator_for_privacy, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :name, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :projects, {:array, :string},
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [items: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_listed or privacy_rule_member))
    end

    has_many :members_join, MyApp.UserWorkspaces do
      source_attribute :id
      destination_attribute :workspace_id
      public? false
      filter expr(not is_nil(members_position))
    end

    many_to_many :members, MyApp.User do
      through MyApp.UserWorkspaces
      source_attribute :id
      source_attribute_on_join_resource :workspace_id
      destination_attribute_on_join_resource :user_id
      destination_attribute :id
      join_relationship :members_join
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_listed or privacy_rule_member))
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

    has_many :members_for_privacy_join, MyApp.UserWorkspaces do
      source_attribute :id
      destination_attribute :workspace_id
      public? false
      filter expr(not is_nil(members_position))
    end

    many_to_many :members_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      through MyApp.UserWorkspaces
      source_attribute :id
      source_attribute_on_join_resource :workspace_id
      destination_attribute_on_join_resource :user_id
      destination_attribute :id
      join_relationship :members_for_privacy_join
      public? false
    end

    has_many :user_workspaces_rows, MyApp.UserWorkspaces do
      source_attribute :id
      destination_attribute :workspace_id
      public? false
      filter expr(not is_nil(workspaces_position))
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_listed,
              :boolean,
              expr(
                not is_nil(^actor(:id)) and exists(user_workspaces_rows, user_id == ^actor(:id))
              ),
              public?: false,
              description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Listed\" (listed_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_member,
              :boolean,
              expr(not is_nil(^actor(:id)) and exists(members_for_privacy, id == ^actor(:id))),
              public?: false,
              description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Member\" (member_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_listed)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_member)
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_listed)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_member)
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :name, :projects] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_listed)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_member)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.ProjectTasks do
  @moduledoc "Join: one row per member of project.tasks_list_custom_task (owner decision finding:list_relationship:639085fbd2d9810b; member when position is not null); the list is not stored. A row written by the app must set the membership column of its list; rows written after the cutover have no Bubble position, so their order among the list's members is not defined."

  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "project_tasks"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :project, ignore?: true
      reference :task, ignore?: true
    end

    custom_indexes do
      index [:task_id], name: "project_tasks_task_id_index"
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :project_id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :task_id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :position, :integer, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :project, MyApp.Project do
      source_attribute :project_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

    belongs_to :task, MyApp.Task do
      source_attribute :task_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_tasks, :boolean, expr(project.privacy_rule_workspace_member),
      public?: false,
      description:
        "The actor may view project.tasks_list_custom_task (the list) on the row's owner record"

    calculate :privacy_visible, :boolean, expr(not is_nil(position) and privacy_tasks),
      public?: false,
      description:
        "The row is a member of a list the actor may view on its owner record (its membership column holds a position, or a true flag)"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Rows of the lists this join replaces: a member of a list the actor may view on its owner"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_visible)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Project, :tasks_for_privacy_join)] do
      description "Rows of project.tasks_list_custom_task read through tasks_for_privacy_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_tasks)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Project, :tasks_join)] do
      description "Rows of project.tasks_list_custom_task read through tasks_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_tasks)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Task, :project_tasks_rows)] do
      description "Rows of project.tasks_list_custom_task read through project_tasks_rows: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_tasks)
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:position] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_tasks)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.UserWorkspaces do
  @moduledoc "Join: one row per member of user.workspaces_list_custom_workspace (owner decision finding:list_relationship:b426fecd8cad673d; member when workspaces_position is not null) and workspace.members_list_user (owner decision finding:privacy_access_list:f86b7e1509c01453; member when members_position is not null); the lists are not stored. A row written by the app must set the membership column of its list; rows written after the cutover have no Bubble position, so their order among the list's members is not defined."

  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "user_workspaces"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :user, ignore?: true
      reference :workspace, ignore?: true
    end

    custom_indexes do
      index [:workspace_id], name: "user_workspaces_workspace_id_index"
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :user_id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :workspace_id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :workspaces_position, :integer, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :members_position, :integer, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :user, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :user_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

    belongs_to :workspace, MyApp.Workspace do
      source_attribute :workspace_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_members,
              :boolean,
              expr(workspace.privacy_rule_listed or workspace.privacy_rule_member),
              public?: false,
              description:
                "The actor may view workspace.members_list_user (the list) on the row's owner record"

    calculate :privacy_visible,
              :boolean,
              expr(
                not is_nil(workspaces_position) or
                  (not is_nil(members_position) and privacy_members)
              ),
              public?: false,
              description:
                "The row is a member of a list the actor may view on its owner record (its membership column holds a position, or a true flag)"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Rows of the lists this join replaces: a member of a list the actor may view on its owner"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_visible)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.User, :workspaces_join)] do
      description "Rows of user.workspaces_list_custom_workspace read through workspaces_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Workspace, :user_workspaces_rows)] do
      description "Rows of user.workspaces_list_custom_workspace read through user_workspaces_rows: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.User, :workspace_members_rows)] do
      description "Rows of workspace.members_list_user read through workspace_members_rows: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_members)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Workspace, :members_for_privacy_join)] do
      description "Rows of workspace.members_list_user read through members_for_privacy_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_members)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Workspace, :members_join)] do
      description "Rows of workspace.members_list_user read through members_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_members)
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:workspaces_position] do
      authorize_if always()
    end

    field_policy [:members_position] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_members)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.FavoriteProject do
  @moduledoc "Join: one row per member of project.viewers_list_user (owner decision finding:list_relationship:1f3c654d5970dd53; member when viewers_listed is true) and user.favorites_list_custom_project (owner decision finding:list_relationship:aa3ba92c1799ff50; member when favorites_position is not null); the lists are not stored. A row written by the app must set the membership column of its list; rows written after the cutover have no Bubble position, so their order among the list's members is not defined."

    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do

    repo MyApp.Repo

      reference :project, ignore?: true

      primary_key?: true,

      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

      allow_nil? true

      public?: false,
      description:
        "The actor may view project.viewers_list_user (the list) on the row's owner record"

    calculate :privacy_visible,
              :boolean,
              expr(
                (viewers_listed == true and privacy_viewers) or not is_nil(favorites_position)
              ),
              public?: false,
              description:
                "The row is a member of a list the actor may view on its owner record (its membership column holds a position, or a true flag)"
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).

  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Rows of the lists this join replaces: a member of a list the actor may view on its owner"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_visible)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Project, :viewers_for_privacy_join)] do
      description "Rows of project.viewers_list_user read through viewers_for_privacy_join: the actor may view the list"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_viewers)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Project, :viewers_join)] do

      authorize_if expr(privacy_viewers)
    end

    policy [action(:read), accessing_from(MyApp.Project, :user_favorites_rows)] do

defmodule MyApp do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource MyApp.Project
    resource MyApp.Task
    resource MyApp.User
    resource MyApp.Workspace
    resource MyApp.ProjectTasks
    resource MyApp.UserWorkspaces
    resource MyApp.FavoriteProject
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy do
  @moduledoc """
  Privacy rules compiled from Bubble to Ash policies by bubble_ex (WTF-356).

  NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE. The policies rest on Bubble semantics not
  yet confirmed by replaying the app (WTF-384/385): do not ship them to
  users until they are. See `verified?/0`.
  """

  @doc "Whether the generated policies are verified against Bubble: not yet."
  def verified?, do: false

  @doc "The relationships of the actor that the policies read."
  def actor_loads, do: []

  @doc "The resource of the actor (Bubble's User)."
  def actor_resource, do: MyApp.User

  @doc """
  Reads the actor (a user or a user ID) afresh with `actor_loads/0`,
  bypassing authorization: the policies must see its current values.
  Call it on every request and LiveView mount, never reuse a stored
  actor. Returns nil (logged out) for nil or an unknown ID.
  """
  def load_actor(nil), do: nil
  def load_actor(%{id: id}), do: load_actor(id)

  def load_actor(id) when is_binary(id) do
    # bubble:ignores_privacy scaffold:load_actor
    case Ash.get(MyApp.User, id, load: actor_loads(), authorize?: false) do
      {:ok, actor} -> actor
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end
end
